name: Nakula
source:
Nakula is the youngest of the Pandawa, and Sadewa's twin brother. Immature and sometimes a tad naughty. He is an exceptional cook, and as a result can often be found in the kitchen. Occasionally, he takes Sadewa to pull pranks on the palace's residents; these are often perceived as rude, although in truth neither means any harm to anyone.
